new_result: A six-mode spectral-square carrier closes without cross-range leverage: rank-three self block uses the finite physical receiver; nearly rank-one self block leaves five cross singular directions and D5 applies; the intermediate approximate-rank-two self block forces a quantitatively invertible original-coordinate pair by the Pluecker identity and operator-norm tail erosion.
theorem_parameters: If |H|=m>=6, 0<=G<=A^2, lambda_6(G[H,H])>=g^2, s3(A)>=s>0, N=binom(m,2), 0<a<b/N and b<g, kappa=b/N-a, then ||p_Q||inf is at most max{2sqrt(6 pi m)/a, pi/kappa, 3*400^(1/3) kappa^(-5/6)s^(-1/6), 5sqrt(2e)/sqrt(g^2-b^2)}.
dense_tail_rule: For A=A_*+T with ||T||op<=delta, all receiver blocks erode by at most delta. If ||A_*x||>=g_*||x|| for every x supported on a six-coordinate H, then (A^2)[H,H]>=(g_*-delta)^2 I_H. No random-smallness claim for X^T T X is used.
stress_family: Six-coordinate H with C0=diag(2,-2,0,0,0,0), four-coordinate J with B0=2[0;I4], arbitrary symmetric spectator Theta, and any globally dense ||T||<=1/64. Final s3>=127/64, (A^2)[H,H]>=(127/64)^2 I6, and the robust indefinite pair gives ||p_Q||inf<=11.1391188620 uniformly in Theta and T.
remaining_implication: From bare s3(A)>=1, force a bounded six-mode spectral-square carrier or an already-paid diffuse-volume/grouped-bank/hub-ridge/physical-pair/rank-two-half-Riesz/scalar-Schur fallback. Six carrier modes are not yet forced by the three-eigenvalue hypothesis.
